articles.title: Flydubai pilot investigated over possible attempt to crash Tel Aviv-bound flight
articles.summary: A Flydubai service from the UAE to Israel made an emergency landing after the copilot stabbed the captain. Eyewitnesses said he attempted to crash the plane before he was subdued by passengers.
